component.name: OmniLyrics
component.summary: Synchronized desktop lyrics with karaoke highlighting
支持逐字高亮的同步桌面歌词

description.p: Follow your music with word-synchronized and bilingual lyrics. Customize the lyric window, connect to supported players, or display lyrics from a paired computer on your local network.
随音乐显示逐字同步和双语歌词。自定义歌词窗口、连接支持的播放器，或显示已配对局域网电脑的歌词。
